definitions.gloss: last departure; last service (train, bus, flight, etc.)
definitions.explanation: The final scheduled departure of a train, bus, or other transport for the day. The opposite of {始発|しはつ} (first departure).

examples.japanese: {終発|しゅうはつ}は{何時|なんじ}ですか。
examples.english: What time is the last departure?

examples.japanese: {終発|しゅうはつ}に{間|ま}に{合|あ}わなかった。
examples.english: I didn't make it in time for the last train.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}み{会|かい}が{長引|ながび}いて、{終発|しゅうはつ}を{逃|のが}してタクシーで{帰|かえ}った。
examples.english: The drinking party dragged on, so I missed the last train and went home by taxi.

notes:
The counterpart of {始発|しはつ} (first departure). While {終電|しゅうでん} (last train) is more commonly used in everyday conversation for trains specifically, {終発|しゅうはつ} is the general term that applies to any mode of transport.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {終発|しゅうはつ}に{乗|の}る: to catch the last departure
- {終発|しゅうはつ}を{逃|のが}す: to miss the last departure
- {終発|しゅうはつ}に{間|ま}に{合|あ}う: to make it in time for the last departure
- {終発|しゅうはつ}{時刻|じこく}: last departure time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {終電|しゅうでん}: last train — specifically for electric trains; more common in everyday speech
- {終バス|しゅうばす}: last bus — specifically for buses
- {始発|しはつ}: first departure — the opposite; the first service of the day
- {最終|さいしゅう}: last; final — often used as {最終|さいしゅう}{便|びん} for the last flight
